search.ai_prompt: Based on these search results, answer the question "{{prompt}}" clearly and helpfully:

create_file.missing_path: ❌ I need the file path. E.g.: "create file test.txt with hello world"

read_file.missing_path: ❌ I need the file path. E.g.: "read file config.json"

edit_file.missing_params: ❌ I need the path and content. E.g.: "edit file.txt and put new text"

execute.missing_command: ❌ I need the command. E.g.: "run npm --version"

run_script.missing_path: ❌ I need the script path. E.g.: "run script build.js"

open_app.missing: ❌ Which application should I open? E.g.: "open notepad" or "open chrome"

open_url.missing: ❌ Which site should I open? E.g.: "open site google.com"

kill_process.missing: ❌ Which process should I terminate? E.g.: "kill process notepad" or "kill 1234"

focus_window.missing: ❌ Which window should I focus? E.g.: "focus chrome window"

window_action.missing: ❌ Which window? E.g.: "minimize chrome" or "close notepad"

type.missing: ❌ What text should I type? E.g.: "type hello world"

shortcut.missing: ❌ Which shortcut? E.g.: "shortcut ctrl+c" or "press ctrl+v"

key.missing: ❌ Which key? E.g.: "press enter" or "key tab 3 times"

move.missing: ❌ I need the coordinates. E.g.: "move cursor to 500, 300"

copy.missing: ❌ What text to copy? E.g.: "copy this text"

project.list_empty:
📂 No projects created yet.
💡 Try: "create a to-do app in React"

remote.add_machine_missing: ❌ I need the alias and IP. E.g.: "add machine server1 192.168.1.100 user root"
remote.remove_machine_missing: ❌ Which machine to remove? E.g.: "remove machine server1"
remote.execute_missing: ❌ I need the machine and command. E.g.: "execute on server1: ls -la"

rag.search_empty: 🔍 No results found in indexed documents. Try indexing first with "index documents".
rag.stats_empty_hint: 💡 No documents indexed. Use "index documents" to get started.
rag.file_upload: 📎 To send files, use the web interface (drag or click the upload button) or send via API.

automation.list_empty:

memory.recall_empty:

memory.profile_empty:

setup.instructions:
💡 **How to configure:**
```
setup openai with sk-proj-abc123...
```
```
configure anthropic with sk-ant-abc123...
```
```
use mistral with key abc123...
```
setup.need_key: 🔑 You need the API key from the provider you've subscribed to.
setup.usage_info:
From now on, all your conversations will use **{{name}}**.
If the API fails, Groq will be used as automatic backup.
setup.useful_commands:
💡 Useful commands:
• "my provider status" — view configuration
• "change model to gpt-4o" — switch model
• "remove my provider" — go back to Groq
• "disable my provider" — temporarily pause

remove.success:
🗑️ **Provider removed successfully!**

The provider "{{name}}" has been deconfigured.
From now on, all conversations will use **Groq** (free).

💡 You can reconfigure at any time with "setup [provider] with [api-key]".

status.no_provider:
📊 **AI Provider Status**

❌ No custom provider configured.
You are using **Groq** (free) as the default provider.

💡 To configure a paid provider: "setup [provider] with [api-key]"
📋 To see options: "list AI providers"
status.active_msg:
✨ Your messages are processed by your paid provider.
If it fails, Groq is used as automatic backup.
status.inactive_msg:
⏸️ Your provider is **disabled**. Messages use Groq.
Say "enable my provider" to reactivate.
status.commands:
💡 Commands:
• "change model to [model]"
• "disable/enable my provider"
• "remove my provider"

toggle.enabled:
▶️ **Provider reactivated!**

"{{name}}" is now **active**. Your messages will be processed by it.
toggle.disabled:
⏸️ **Provider disabled.**

"{{name}}" is now **paused**. Messages will use Groq (free).

Say "enable my provider" to reactivate.

model.changed:
🤖 **Model changed!**

Model: **{{model}}**
Provider: {{provider}}

Your next messages will use this model.
model.no_provider: ❌ No provider configured. Configure first with "setup [provider] with [api-key]".

provider.onboarding:
🔌 **Premium AI Integration**

Did you know you can use your own AI provider?

🆓 **Current:** Groq (free, LLaMA 3.3 70B)
💎 **Premium:** OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, DeepSeek, xAI and more!

**Why?**
✨ More advanced models (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, etc.)
📊 No rate limits
🔒 Your own account and control

**How to configure:**
Say: "setup [provider] with [api-key]"
Example: "setup openai with sk-proj-abc123..."

Groq stays as free backup!
